summary: VitaGuide App Bug Fix Testing - Iteration 4: Two bug fixes verified. Bug 1: Recipe filtering now correctly shows only matching catalog recipes when symptom chips selected (not all 30). Bug 2: Recipe images render with 180px height via CSS workaround, multiple recipe cards are visible and expandable with ingredients/steps detail view. All 18 backend API tests passed, all frontend E2E tests passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug Fix Testing Complete: (1) Recipe filtering by symptom_tags working - GET /api/recipes?tags=Müdigkeit returns 3 recipes, not all 30. When no chips selected, only LLM-generated recipes show. (2) Recipe images render via CSS class .rimg-wrap injected in +html.tsx with 180px height, background-size:cover. (3) Recipe cards are expandable - clicking shows Zutaten (ingredients) and Zubereitung (steps). (4) Multiple recipe cards visible and clickable (4 cards found: 1 LLM + 3 catalog). All tabs (overview, supplements, nutrition, recipes) work. Language switching DE/IT verified.
